ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Printer Driver Empty Manufacturer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious printer driver installation with an empty Manufacturer value Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Print\\\\Environments\\\\Windows\\ x64\\\\Drivers.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Manufacturer.*")) AND Details = "\(Empty\)") AND  NOT (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\CutePDF\\ Writer\\ v4\\\.0\\\\.*") OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\VNC\\ Printer\\ \\(PS\\)\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\VNC\\ Printer\\ \\(UD\\)\\\\.*")) OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Version\\-3\\\\PDF24\\\\.*"))
